issues.description: For records in your dataset where `pixel_mean` >= 0.115 AND `pixel_mean` < 0.130, we found a significantly higher number of underconfident predictions (223 samples, corresponding to 15.43% of the predictions in the data slice).

We found 3 examples for which the model provides a different output depending on whether it is computing on a single data point or on a batch.

When feature “pixel_mean” is perturbed with the transformation “Add Gaussian noise”, the model changes its prediction in 10.8% of the cases. We expected the predictions not to be affected by this transformation.
